name: EPIC 212698200
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 18.3 solar radii and 0.99 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212698200 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM radius (solar radii) 18.338486 (16th-84th percentiles 17.148871-19.761705), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 8,561 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.99 solar masses and 18.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,568 K at its surface.
